title: Declare the test's real ATDD phase

facts.note: Any test file (existing or new) in a Bun project; no change-type restriction — the rule governs every test file carrying a URN.
Required scope condition: URN presence anywhere in the test file (as detected by bun_tester_discipline_detector). Files without a URN are skipped.
Alternative trigger (any one of the three phase findings suffices): no phase declaration in the URN-bearing test file.

values: `// Phase:` value outside RED, UNIT, SMOKE, E2E
facts.note: Alternative trigger: declared value not in the closed vocabulary.

values: declared phase does not match the role/proof boundary exercised
facts.note: Alternative trigger: whether RED/UNIT/SMOKE/E2E fits the test's real role can only be judged by reading the test.

fires: A test file carrying a URN has no `// Phase:` line.
A test file carrying a URN declares `// Phase:` with a value outside RED, UNIT, SMOKE, E2E.
A test file carrying a URN that exercises the real assembled path is labelled UNIT so that collaborator substitution is permitted.
A test file carrying a URN labels a passing or vacuous case RED only because a RED marker is easy to add.
doesNotFire: A test file with no URN (skipped by this rule).
A test file carrying a URN whose `// Phase:` value is one of RED, UNIT, SMOKE, E2E AND matches the role and proof boundary the test actually exercises.

given: A test file that carries a URN
when: you write, bind or edit that test file
then: Declare `// Phase:` with exactly one of RED, UNIT, SMOKE, E2E, matching what the test actually does and the proof boundary it exercises.
prefer: Derive the phase from the test's role: RED = current acceptance proof intentionally failing first; UNIT = isolated local behavior; SMOKE = real assembled path/infrastructure with operator-observable evidence; E2E = end-to-end journey through the assembled system.

After declaring, check the test meets what that phase now requires: a RED test must fail first and must assert behaviour; a SMOKE test must assert something operator-observable and must not substitute collaborators. Confirm the phase matches the boundary really exercised.
avoid: Omitting the phase (silently exempts the test from every phase-gated rule).
Choosing a weaker label to silence a phase-gated rule; phase selection is part of the proof contract.
Relabelling a real-path SMOKE or assembled E2E proof as UNIT to permit substitution.
Labelling a passing or vacuous case RED because a RED marker is easy to add.
Inventing a new phase value in an extension; the vocabulary is fixed by core.
unless: The file carries no URN (such files are skipped).
why: The phase is not documentation: it selects which other rules apply (e.g. RED must fail first and assert behaviour; SMOKE must assert something operator-observable and must not substitute collaborators), so a perfectly identified test without the right phase is ungoverned or governed by the wrong obligations.
evidence: Every test file carrying a URN has a `// Phase:` line whose value is one of RED, UNIT, SMOKE, E2E (bun_tester_discipline_detector reports no finding).

Reviewer confirms the declared phase matches the boundary the case really exercises and that the phase-specific obligations are now evaluated against it: a RED test fails first and asserts behaviour; a SMOKE test asserts something operator-observable and substitutes no collaborators.
verifier_detail: Detector: bun_tester_discipline_detector (validator). Applies to every test file carrying a URN and reads its `// Phase:` field; files with no URN are skipped. Stack-neutral obligation, Bun-specific detector.
Closed vocabulary: RED, UNIT, SMOKE, E2E. Any other value or a missing field is a finding. Adding a phase is a core change, not an extension change.

Term phase_field: `// Phase:` with RED, UNIT, SMOKE or E2E. Term phase_gated_rule: a rule that only applies to one phase; without a declared phase a test is exempt from the whole quality surface by omission.

Phase-gated obligations this field selects: a RED test must fail first and must assert behaviour; a SMOKE test must assert something operator-observable and must not substitute collaborators. Without a declared phase none of these can be evaluated.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.
Stack-neutral obligation, Bun-specific detector; realized by bun_tester_discipline_detector (implementation type validator).
Exists separately from the URN rule because a test can be perfectly identified and still be ungoverned or governed by the wrong obligations.
Source summary: Requires a `Phase:` field from the closed vocabulary.
Source name: Every test declares its ATDD phase.
